definitions.explanation: To make an effort to do something.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{方法|ほうほう}を{試|こころ}みる。
{説得|せっとく}を{試|こころ}みた。
{挑戦|ちょうせん}を{試|こころ}みる。
{脱出|だっしゅつ}を{試|こころ}みたが{失敗|しっぱい}した。
examples.english: I attempted to escape but failed.

examples.japanese: {何度|なんど}も{交渉|こうしょう}を{試|こころ}みたが、{相手|あいて}は{応|おう}じなかった。
examples.english: I attempted negotiations many times, but the other party would not respond.

notes:
{試|こころ}みる means to try or attempt something, typically in a deliberate, formal context.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を for direct object: {新|あたら}しい{方法|ほうほう}を{試|こころ}みる

COMPARISON OF 'TO TRY' VERBS:
- {試|こころ}みる: to attempt (formal, deliberate, serious)
- {試|ため}す: to test, try out (to see results)
- やってみる: to try doing (casual, experiential)
- {挑戦|ちょうせん}する: to challenge, take on

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {説得|せっとく}を{試|こころ}みる: to attempt persuasion
- {脱出|だっしゅつ}を{試|こころ}みる: to attempt escape
- {交渉|こうしょう}を{試|こころ}みる: to attempt negotiation
- {実験|じっけん}を{試|こころ}みる: to attempt an experiment

RELATED WORDS:
- {試|こころ}み: attempt, trial, experiment (noun)
- {試行錯誤|しこうさくご}: trial and error
